name: IOGP Life-Saving Rules (Report 459 - 2018 Edition)
description: Standardized set of 9 Life-Saving Rules established by the International Association of Oil & Gas Producers to mitigate fatal and serious incidents in E&P operations.

rules.name: Bypassing Safety Controls
rules.description: Obtain authorization before overriding or disabling safety controls.
rules.guidance: Understand and use safety-critical equipment and procedures. Never bypass, disable, or tamper with safety controls without formal authorization.

rules.name: Confined Space
rules.description: Obtain authorization before entering a confined space.
rules.guidance: Confirm energy sources are isolated. Verify gas test is completed and atmosphere is monitored. Confirm standby attendant is posted.

rules.name: Driving
rules.guidance: Always wear seatbelts. Do not exceed speed limits. Do not use mobile phones while driving. Adhere to journey management plans.

rules.name: Energy Isolation
rules.description: Verify isolation and zero energy before work begins.
rules.guidance: Apply Lockout/Tagout (LOTO). Verify electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pressure isolations. Bleed off stored energy.

rules.name: Hot Work
rules.guidance: Identify hazards and obtain hot work permit. Clear flammables and conduct continuous gas monitoring. Ensure fire watch and firefighting equipment.

rules.name: Line of Fire
rules.description: Keep yourself and others out of the line of fire.
rules.guidance: Position yourself to avoid pinch points, moving machinery, dropped objects, and pressurized releases. Establish and respect exclusion zones.

rules.name: Safe Mechanical Lifting
rules.description: Plan lifting operations and control the area.
rules.guidance: Ensure lifting equipment is certified and inspected. Never exceed working load limits (WLL). Establish physical exclusion barriers.

rules.name: Work Authorization
rules.description: Work with a valid permit when required.
rules.guidance: Confirm permit is valid and authorized. Understand the Job Safety Analysis (JSA). Conduct Tool Box Talk (TBT) before starting.

rules.name: Working at Height
rules.description: Protect yourself against a fall when working at height.
rules.guidance: Use fall arrest equipment with 100% tie-off above designated heights. Inspect scaffolds, ladders, and safety harnesses before use.
